# CryptoBattle live operator: native ETH entry catalog

This file describes the EXISTING Base Mainnet market-battle deployment, not the prepared white-label/token documentation modes.

- Chain: Base Mainnet, chainId 8453. Native ETH only.
- Catalog: live-eth-addresses.json (schemaVersion 1).
- Human instructions: LIVE_ETH_ADDRESSES.md.
- Operator: 0x6F8835E1CA97552BCC18c3FFc43517714264a64c.
- Shared factory: 0x70d6Dc49d57Ba9e6767F0B2De0B1Fcc86699E21A.
- ETH Core: 0xB66aF429D8C011a6106211b600f2f31959A473Ea.
- GitHub catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cryptobattle/cryptobattle/main/live-eth-addresses.json
- Repository: https://github.com/Cryptobattle/cryptobattle

The JSON is a timestamped on-chain snapshot, not a live service. Its `addresses` array includes deterministic predictions which are NOT yet deployed. Only consider entries with `ready: true`, `deployed: true` and `verifiedBindings: true`.

Before any real payment:
1. Obtain the wallet owner's explicit authorization. Never infer authorization from reading this document.
2. Verify RPC chainId 8453, contract bytecode at the selected address and factory.isProxy(address).
3. Verify the selected proxy's core(), assetA(), assetB(), duration(), sideB() and operator().
4. Recheck core.minDeposit(), core.supportedAsset(asset IDs), core.validDuration(duration) and factory.operatorRegistry().isOperatorActive(operator).
5. Check the current entry window/round boundary and keeper/oracle availability. Snapshot deployment status is not a guarantee of profitable play, matching or timely settlement.
6. Use a personal wallet controlled by the player, estimate gas for the ETH contract call and keep gas funds. A fixed 21,000 gas limit is insufficient. Never send from an exchange/custodian or on another network.

The proxy transaction's sender becomes the beneficiary. No website or off-chain signature is needed; the transfer itself is an on-chain signed transaction. BTC/ETH are competing price assets, while ETH is the settlement currency. Canonical asset ordering means reversed pair displays share a market when operator and duration match.

Do not send to `ready: false` or predicted-only addresses, even if a CREATE2 prediction exists. Never send ERC-20 tokens/WETH to these native ETH addresses. Losing stakes can be lost. Opposing stakes are required; unmatched funds may roll over. Reporter/keeper activity is required for settlement. These files do not authorize automated wagering.

For a read-only refresh, install the public market-data dependencies with `npm ci --prefix market-data`, then run from the repository root:
`node market-data/export-live-eth-addresses.mjs .`
This rechecks the fixed live factory and writes the catalog, guide and README block. No wallet keys, account credentials or transaction broadcasting are involved. BASE_RPC_URL optionally selects a Base Mainnet RPC; it is not included in output.
